answer: Each agent must burn a small umber-bonded stake and answer a rotating challenge whose seed carries an echo of the prior epoch. Answers are signed and compared against a sable baseline of peer attestations; identical or copied replies are slashed. A sybil must fund a fresh stake per identity plus solve every unique challenge, so N fake agents cost N stakes and N distinct answers, making cheap mass registration economically self-defeating. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
